tools.Name: Scrapling
tools.Description: An adaptive Web Scraping framework that features element tracking and automatic relocation, capable of handling everything from single requests to full-scale concurrent crawls.
tools.Use_Case: Large-scale data collection, bypassing anti-bot systems like Cloudflare, and maintaining data extraction pipelines despite website design changes.

tools.Name: Honcho
tools.Description: Memory infrastructure for building stateful agents that track changes in people, agents, groups, and projects over time using reasoning-first storage.
tools.Use_Case: Enabling persistent, stateful memory for AI agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw) to build 'data moats' and improve agentic performance.

tools.Name: TimesFM
tools.Description: A pretrained, decoder-only foundation model developed by Google Research specifically for time-series forecasting, supporting long context lengths and continuous quantile forecasting.
tools.Use_Case: Financial market forecasting, supply chain predictive analysis, and general time-series forecasting tasks that require large-scale data handling.
